'''Temako''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The world was the location of [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec's]] manufacturing headquarters during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
